page: Amazon Web Services r7i.24xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 virtual CPUs, which correspond to 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processor is an Intel Xeon 8488C running at 3.2 GHz, equipped with a 105 MB L3 cache. The system is provisioned with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 38 Gbps.

In benchmark testing, the r7i.24xlarge demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, scoring in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests. Its memory subsystem delivers strong performance, with read-only large block memory bandwidth reaching 228.17 GB/sec and write large block bandwidth at 95.44 GB/sec. The instance excels in specialized tasks, achieving top-tier performance in Passmark CPU encryption, Geekbench ray tracing, and Geekbench image processing. It also supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for accelerated matrix operations.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated hardware allocation, the r7i.24xlarge offers high resource density for memory-bound applications. It represents a qualitatively cost-efficient option for enterprise workloads that require massive memory footprints without the overhead of local storage. The instance is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and medium-to-large scale LLM inference tasks.
